tuning.selection: Per maze: mean over registered points within seed, then mean over seeds 42--46; maximize validation success, within 1e-12 of maximum choose smaller p.

test.derivation: Recompute saved selection from complete verified tuning rows at derivation. Run twenty seeds only where p* differs from 2/3; otherwise reuse admissibility rows.

control.independence: May run beside tuning; no selection dependency.

references.policy: Reuse verified archived rows and registrations; never rerun a reference arm.

with_four_fifths.reservation_rule: Actual tuning groups of 20--40 jobs use their own maximum limit; control and conditional test use twenty-seed per-maze arrays. Test reserves the worst candidate per maze.
with_four_fifths.estimate_rule: Allocation CPUTimeRAW at seed 42; full-block cost conservatively proxies validation-only cost when unmeasured. Unpiloted candidates use the most expensive pilot setting of that agent on that maze.
with_four_fifths.limit_rule: max(3, ceil((2 * body wall seconds + 60) / 60)) minutes; shared node watchdog keeps 30 seconds.
with_four_fifths.limitation: One-seed forecast, no guarantee about new seeds. Every attempt and outstanding hard limit remains charged.

analysis.primary: Mean over registered points within each seed, then mean and SE over twenty seeds.
analysis.final: Final registered point per seed, then mean and SE over twenty seeds.
analysis.coincident_arms: Omit S@selected minus S@2/3 where selection is 2/3; these arms coincide.
analysis.dose_interpretation: H@1/2 approximately matches realized copies of S@2/3. Report actual shares; this is a rule contrast at similar dose, not exact dose matching.
analysis.decomposition: At each seed and point, and both aggregate views, verify exactly with Fraction: (S@2/3 - H@1/2) + (H@1/2 - H@2/3) = S@2/3 - H@2/3.
analysis.threshold_arithmetic: Integer exhaustive successes over fixed test pair counts; Fraction for mean curves and >= both baseline final mean test thresholds. First nominal point, no interpolation, null if unreached.
analysis.tuning_table: Each maze/candidate: mean and SE of five seed checkpoint-mean validation scores; descriptive equally weighted across-maze mean per candidate.
diagnostics: wall bumps / copies where measured; historical missing values remain null
first-action value minus actual return on test: all, successful and failed pairs
objective calls by scoring, admissibility selection and provenance
analysis.diagnostic_scope: Every new/reused arm and tuning setting in both registered views; tuning has validation-only value diagnostics, test value diagnostics are unmeasured until a three-block run. Empty conditional groups stay null with contributing seed counts.
analysis.diagnostic_aggregation: Compute route shares from counters within each row. In checkpoint_mean average rows equally within seed, then report mean/SE across seeds; final_point uses the last row. Values, knowledge, population and memory follow the same views. Also report cumulative final cost totals. Empty groups are null with contributing seed counts.
analysis.failed_value_groups: Recover failed-pair conditional means from exhaustive integer success counts and the archived all/successful means by algebraic decomposition; empty groups null, binary64 rounding remains. No extra evaluation calls.
analysis.costs: Report pilot, tuning, conditional test and control separately; process CPU=user+system, allocated CPU from sacct. Reused historical costs separate, never charged again.
analysis.post_hoc: Every unregistered comparison, including all success comparisons against ACS2, is labelled post hoc.

identity_checks.reference_two_thirds: Pilot seed42 and all tuning seeds42--46 at p=2/3 reproduce every admissibility validation, learning and knowledge field in IEEE754 binary64 bits at every point. STOP before selection on mismatch.
identity_checks.selected: Test seeds42--46 reproduce validation-only tuning learning/knowledge and validation; seed42 reproduces all pilot blocks at the same setting.
identity_checks.control: Every seed42 point and all three blocks reproduce pilot.
identity_checks.exclusions: Only grid_identity.OMIT: source/host/time provenance and arm annotation; no learning or knowledge field excluded.

execution.dispatch: Lean stage-2 dispatcher: one registered 20--40-job array per active stream, at most two streams and forty running jobs. Wait for a stream to become terminal before its next array; do not enqueue the entire multi-array manifest. Re-derive and check admission before each sbatch.
execution.accounting: One scope containing all pilot, tuning, test and control roots; pilot offset zero to avoid double charging.
execution.admission: Before each sbatch mechanically rederive approved manifest; check grant, sbatch --test-only and pilot + used + reserved + new hard limits <= approved CPU-hours.
execution.guards: Immutable clean source/binary/operations, hardware/preset/row/identity guards, shared STOP on real failure; 20--40 jobs at a time.
execution.archive: ~/tu_runs/hindsight-proportion/ and ~/Desktop/tu-runs/hindsight-proportion/; independently verify both copies before analysis.

authorization: Stage 1 pilot only is authorized, at most 5 CPU-hours including reservations. Stop after registration; tuning, control and test require explicit approval of plan bytes and CPU-hour limit.
